name: Revelo Payroll
description_en:
Revelo Payroll is a vendor-described payroll and benefits service for remote engineers. Its specific payroll landing page advertises broad country coverage, while the current platform and general pricing pages focus on hiring and managing Latin American tech talent with payroll, benefits and contracts included in a wider engagement.

That distinction matters: a payroll-only service fee and an all-in developer hiring rate are different products. This draft retains the dedicated payroll record and documents what must be confirmed about availability, countries, employer responsibility, billing period and included benefits.
description_zh:
Revelo Payroll 是供应商描述的远程工程师工资及福利服务。其独立工资落地页宣传广泛国家覆盖，当前平台和总体定价则重点为拉美技术人员招聘管理，将工资、福利和合同纳入更广合作。

工资单独服务费与包含开发者的全包招聘价不同。本稿保留独立工资记录，并说明可用性、国家、雇主责任、计费期间及福利包含项需确认。

core_features.explanation_en: The dedicated payroll page describes compensation, payment services, PTO, reimbursements and team management.
core_features.explanation_zh: 独立工资页描述薪酬、付款服务、PTO、报销和团队管理。

core_features.explanation_en: The platform describes benefits/deductions, localized contracts, payslips, salary/tax payment and local filing as vendor services.
core_features.explanation_zh: 平台将福利扣款、本地合同、工资单、工资税款付款及当地申报列为供应商服务。

core_features.explanation_en: Current platform positioning connects candidate selection and onboarding to payroll, benefits and ongoing remote-team administration.
core_features.explanation_zh: 当前平台定位把选人入职与工资、福利及持续远程团队运营相连。

pricing.summary_en: Dedicated payroll page displays US$450 per engineer without an explicit billing interval. Broader all-in hiring rates include salary and are a different offer; standalone quote required.
pricing.summary_zh: 独立工资页展示每工程师450美元，未明确计费期间。含工资的更广招聘全包价是另一产品，需要独立报价。

sources.title: Revelo Payroll Solutions
sources.research_notes_en: Read dedicated payroll country claim, US$450 per-engineer card, included/free versus paid access labels and payroll/benefit list; billing interval absent.

sources.title: Revelo: The #1 payroll & compliance platform  for managing remote devs based in Latin America
sources.research_notes_en: Read current LatAm engineer focus, salary/tax/filing/contract/payslip scope and explicit standalone integration qualification.

sources.title: Revelo's Pricing
sources.research_notes_en: Read broader all-in hiring rate, salary/benefit inclusion, monthly invoicing and hiring-trial terms without transferring them to payroll-only.

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_zh: 确认独立工资服务范围
sections.en: The dedicated /solutions/payroll page advertises payroll in 150+ countries and a Payroll Premium card. The current platform instead describes a self-service system for Latin American developers, and the general pricing page sells an all-in hiring engagement. These pages do not establish that every listed country has identical current payroll-only availability. Before selection, state whether the company already has engineers to administer or wants Revelo to recruit them, and ask which country, employment relationship and contract apply. Do not import the company’s unrelated AI training-data or software-development services into the payroll feature list.
sections.zh: 独立 /solutions/payroll 页宣传 150 多国工资及 Payroll Premium 卡，当前平台则描述面向拉美开发者的自助系统，总体价格页销售全包招聘合作。这些页面不能证明各国当前都提供相同独立工资服务。选择前需明确已有工程师待管理，还是希望 Revelo 招聘，并询问国家、雇佣关系及合同。公司的 AI 训练数据或软件开发服务不纳入工资功能表。

sections.title_en: Trace salary, deductions and service responsibility
sections.title_zh: 追踪工资、扣款及服务责任
sections.en: The platform lists salary and tax payment, benefits and deductions, local filing, contracts, payslip delivery and onboarding. The payroll landing adds PTO, reimbursements, rewards and team management. An illustrative acceptance case would use one approved absence and reimbursement, then reconcile the employee’s payslip, local-currency payment and customer invoice. Confirm who legally employs the engineer, approves variable pay, funds the payment and corrects a rejected or inaccurate result. Broad legal-liability coverage claims are vendor descriptions, not an independently verified indemnity or guarantee of compliance.
sections.zh: 平台列出工资税款付款、福利扣款、本地申报、合同、工资单交付和入职，工资落地页再提 PTO、报销、奖励和团队管理。验收示例可使用已批准缺勤及报销，核对员工工资单、本币付款和客户发票。需确认谁是法律雇主、批准变量、提供资金以及更正拒付或错误。广泛法律责任覆盖属于供应商描述，不是独立核实的赔偿或合规保证。

sections.title_en: Do not treat US$450 as an all-in salary price
sections.title_zh: 不要把 US$450 当作含工资总价
sections.en: The dedicated payroll card states “Per engineer US $450” but does not explicitly attach a billing interval in the reviewed text. It labels PTO, local currency and health/dental insurance as free, and accounting and office supplies as paid access; verify exactly which premium, coverage and service costs those labels represent. The general pricing page’s calculator and comprehensive rate include developer salary, benefits, payroll and hiring support, so its monthly invoice and two-week risk-free hiring trial cannot automatically be applied to the standalone payroll card. Obtain a quote separating engineer compensation, service fee, benefits, taxes, FX, setup and termination. No recurring payroll price was normalized.
sections.zh: 独立工资卡写“Per engineer US $450”，但所读正文没有明确计费周期，PTO、本币及医疗牙科保险标免费，会计和办公用品标付费访问，需确认具体保费、覆盖及服务成本。总体价格页的计算器和全包费包含开发者工资、福利、工资处理及招聘支持，其月度发票和两周无风险招聘试用不能自动用于独立工资卡。报价应分开工程师薪酬、服务费、福利、税、汇兑、设置和终止，本稿未归一为固定月度工资价格。

sections.en: The platform FAQ calls the system standalone and says it may not directly integrate with every HR system, with unique needs routed to client success. Do not promise a native connection to the buyer’s existing stack. Prepare employee records, salary components, leave ownership, country obligations and accounting requirements, then request a demonstration of an amended payslip, failed payment, benefit change and exported invoice. Revelo may fit engineering teams using managed LatAm talent administration; generic multi-country payroll buyers need clearer service evidence. Actual availability, billing period, benefits, contract, hosting, exports and recovery remain unverified. No candidate selection, account, payroll, filing, payment or trial was executed; no open-source license was established.
sections.zh: 平台 FAQ 将系统称为独立方案，说明未必直接连接每种 HR 系统，特殊需要交客户成功团队处理，因此不能承诺与买家既有系统原生连接。需准备员工档案、薪酬组成、休假责任、国家义务和会计要求，并演示工资单修改、付款失败、福利变更和发票导出。采用托管拉美人才运营的工程团队可评估 Revelo，通用多国工资买家还需更清楚证据。实际可用性、计费期、福利、合同、托管、导出及恢复未核实，未选人、操作账户工资申报付款或试用，也未确立开源许可。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Standalone availability, 150+ country scope, billing period and relationship to current LatAm hiring offer were not confirmed beyond public pages.
research_gaps.zh: 除公开页面外，未确认独立可用性、150多国范围、计费期间及与当前拉美招聘方案的关系。

research_gaps.en: No account, payroll, tax filing, benefit, integration, payment or hiring trial was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行账户、工资、报税、福利、集成、付款或招聘试用。
